d.ko: Medieval Europe is in the middle of religious upheaval and many a preacher predict the imminent end of the world. Immerse yourself in a dark fantasy story with true historical events in the background. You'll be facing intricate puzzles, challenging battles and cunning stealth.

d.zh: 本作以真实的历史事件为背景：中世纪的欧洲正处于宗教动荡的时代，许多传教士都预言世界末日即将到来。玩家将沉浸于一个暗黑奇幻故事中，面对错综复杂的谜题、富于挑战性的战斗以及需要技巧的潜行任务。
